what_this_merge_does_not_do: It does not register any generation. current_head is root5 at sequence 5 and stays there.

It does not authorise applying CP-01. work/cp01/cp01-apply.candidate.sql is included as a DRAFT that carries its own MUST-NOT-BE-RUN banner and two unresolved placeholders; merging it records the draft, it does not clear it. CP-01 requires its own independent review and its own Owner decision.
It does not decide the CP-01-versus-registration ordering question. That question is put to the Owner separately and is not resolved by merging.
It does not move the Owner window, extend it, or create a new one.
It does not reserve, consume, or restore any budget. charged_seconds stays 9906 of 10506 and the single 600-second allocation remains untouched.
It does not create a trust root, a signing identity, a paid budget, a model budget, or any production authority.
It does not change any of the fifteen control-plane functions.
It does not accept the final root6 registration body. Round 12 accepted the review subject only; the final body has two fields nobody has reviewed yet and needs a further independent pass.
